Needs a branch refresh before merge. The code and fixture checks passed. The PR conflicts with current main.

What looks good:

- The case contains the model, generator, script, project, NC program, and comparison README.
- Both catalog tests regenerate the case and compare the posted NC program byte for byte.
- The README records the known Slot end-wall leftover and links issue #2906.
- The diff changes no UI code, importer code, dependencies, process files, or existing goldens.

Local results:

- Base checked: `upstream/main` at `83c53732be0cc938929b507c93d19abc39e5d72b`.
- The trial merge failed in `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs`. I aborted the merge without resolving the code conflict.
- All builds and tests below ran locally on the unchanged PR head, in `.claude/worktrees/review-2913`. They do not validate a merged tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The complete `example_catalog` suite passed all 4 tests.
- After both mutation checks, `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: passed all 4 tests again.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: passed for `2d/contour-tabs`, `2d/first-part`, and `2d/slots`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run:

- I searched the test sources for readers of `examples/catalog`. The readers are `example_catalog` and `catalog_render`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 1 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. The ignored test is the screenshot renderer.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Safety checks and mutations:

- I used the safety tier because this PR adds geometry and a posted NC fixture. No existing golden moved.
- I read all 847 lines of the new NC program. The row levels, helix entry, loop returns, feeds, and final retract agree with the case description.
- Independent NC counts agree with the README: Slot has 19 motion blocks and no arcs. Trochoidal slot has 803 motion blocks and 459 arcs.
- An independent OBJ check passed: 584 vertices, 844 faces, paired directed edges, finite coordinates, correct bounds, and correct volume.
- Mutation 1: I changed the Slot script stepdown from 3 mm to 6 mm. The script rebuild test failed with `2d/slots: build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc`.
- Mutation 2: I used the NC program rebuilt from that script. The new test failed with `the Slot cuts two levels with a 3 mm stepdown`: actual `[6.0]`, expected `[9.0, 6.0]`.
- I restored both files. The complete catalog suite then passed. The working tree is clean.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:301`: resolve the conflict with the hole-work test added on main. Keep both tests and the turning-case checks from main. Run the quick gate and both catalog suites on the refreshed head. Refresh at merge time, as the repository rules require.

Notes:

- No machine test or ignored screenshot render ran.
- The PR stays a draft and receives `conflicts`. There is no code defect finding beyond the merge conflict.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the review on 97192c1d72df7018a065df84d3c80e9688187c03. The new head is 60a509027228013d8931fc548c8edda64af67e40.

Finding 1, the conflict in `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs`:

- Merge commit 0cf5bfebd merges `upstream/main` (97a880c) into the branch. It is not a rebase.
- I kept the two tests: `slots_case_posts_a_slot_and_a_trochoidal_slot_to_the_same_floor` and `hole_work_case_posts_drilling_cycles_and_thread_helix`.
- The turning-case checks and the per-case modules from main are unchanged.

A second problem showed after the merge:

- Main now has the test `contract::every_case_has_two_named_test_results`. It failed on the merged tree with `missing case test catalog_2d_slots::regenerates`.
- Commit 60a509027 adds the module `catalog_2d_slots` with `regenerates` and `rebuilds`.
- Each of these tests takes about 40 s in debug when it runs alone. In the parallel suite, the two tests went over the 60 s budget. They also pushed `catalog_turning_cone_thread` over its budget.
- The budget message says to move such a case to `app heavy: example_catalog`. The two tests now have `#[ignore = "heavy lane (#2861 2d/slots): ..."]`.
- The default suite keeps `slots_case_posts_a_slot_and_a_trochoidal_slot_to_the_same_floor`, which reads the committed `slots.nc`.
- `docs/decisions/2861-slots-example.md` records this decision and the options that I dropped.

Mutation check:

- Without the module, `contract::every_case_has_two_named_test_results` failed. With the module, it passed.

Results on 60a509027:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: ok. `app:example_catalog` passed the whole suite in 585 s.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: ok. `catalog_2d_slots::rebuilds` and `catalog_2d_slots::regenerates` passed in release.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: ok.

Not run: `catalog_render` and the screenshot renderer.

Please review the new head again. The merge commit includes a hand resolution, so it is a DELTA refresh.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `conflicts` or `needs-rework`. The coordinator session of NeoTech merged `main` into this branch.

- New head: `fa0c3215a01118ef80db380652d2c03cd3a36214`.
- Merge commit: `fa0c3215a`.
- Conflicted file `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs`: both sides added case modules. Resolution: kept `catalog_2d_slots` (this PR, heavy-lane ignores unchanged) and the `main` modules `catalog_turning_bushing`, `catalog_turning_contour_finishes` and `catalog_turning_taper_finish`, in list order.
- Delta class: DELTA.
- No repair commit.

Gate: a trial merge of `main` at `ee91ac3e5`, this head and other PRs passed the batch tier on Windows: 998 steps, 2 failed. The two failed steps belong to other PRs of that trial merge. An agent that did not write the change ran it.

Ready for a re-check.

Review at head fa0c3215a (delta review; the earlier review at 97192c1d7 stands for the docs case itself).

What changed since 97192c1d7:
- Two refresh merges of main. Each had one conflict, in `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs`, and both sides were kept: the diff against main's file shows zero deletions of main's lines, only the PR's additions. No safety logic is involved.
- New commit `60a509027` gives the case its heavy-lane twins (`catalog_2d_slots::regenerates` / `rebuilds`) and the `PostedOp` reader, plus `docs/decisions/2861-slots-example.md`. The ignore reasons name the lane and the timing. That is the right form.

One requested change:
- `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` is now 471 lines (380 at the reviewed head; the PR adds 91). AGENTS.md "400-line files" calls for a split at about 400. Split along the seam the file already shows: one `#[path]` sibling per case group (the `catalog_2d_slots` mod and its helpers are a clean cut), the way `viewport_bar` does it.

Everything else is clean. Labels are not changed by this review.
